content.title: How to watch Angels vs. Yankees: TV channel and streaming options for April 13
content.text: The New York Yankees and Los Angeles Angels clash in the first of a four-game series on Monday at Yankee Stadium, at 7:05 p.m. ET. Will Warren (1-0, 3.07 ERA) gets the start for the Yankees, who are 8-7 this season and second in the AL East. Yusei Kikuchi (0-2, 6.75 ERA) is expected to start for the Angels, who are 8-8 and third in the AL West.How to watch Los Angeles Angels vs. New York Yankees Venue: Yankee Stadium Time: 7:05 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: YES and FDSW Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub.
